Create a custom systemd service unit
output:
cat > /etc/systemd/system/myapp.service << 'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=My App
[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/myapp
Restart=always
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF && systemctl daemon-reload

instruction: Start a custom systemd unit immediately
Create a systemd timer to schedule tasks
output:
cat > /etc/systemd/system/mytask.timer << 'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Run mytask daily
[Timer]
OnCalendar=daily
[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
EOF && systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl enable --now mytask.timer
